messages:
anya: quick PR to tidy provisioning examples for Dedicated capacity. added a short reserved vs burst example + one-line migration note. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4809. can someone quick-review?

sam: will do. please standardize field names to `target_utilization_pct` and `cooldown_seconds`.

marta: add a one-line eviction caveat for burst pools and link the internal eviction page.

kevin: adding a tiny SDK one-liner for python: `client.provision_capacity(tenant_id="team-sky", pool_type="burst", policy={"target_utilization_pct":70, "cooldown_seconds":300})`

anya: great. also include this CLI for tenant admins: `redwoodctl capacity set-policy --tenant team-sky --type burst --target 70 --cooldown 300`. merge after these small edits pass CI.

docs-bot: Style: present tense, examples <= 12 lines, param links. :memo:
